customers.name: Sara Nasser
customers.notes: Asked about 1-bedroom units in May; preferred Arabic.

policy.pricing: Lusail Residences 2-bedroom units are listed from QAR 1,650,000 to QAR 2,150,000. A 10% booking deposit reserves a unit for 14 days. Never promise discounts.
policy.financing: We do not give financing advice. Customers arrange financing with their own bank; we can share the developer payment plan: 10% on booking, 40% during construction, 50% on handover.
policy.viewing: Viewings of the show apartment in Tower B run Saturday to Thursday, 09:00 to 19:00. Offer a specific slot and ask the customer to confirm.
policy.communication: Reply in the customer's language. First replies to Arabic enquiries are bilingual, Arabic first.
